title: Website change monitor input
description: Paste URLs or chain from Sitemap / URL-status dataset or DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT. Each URL is fetched over HTTP, text-extracted (optional CSS selector), hashed, and compared to a persistent snapshot store. No browser, no LLM.

urls.title: URLs to monitor
urls.description: One or more URLs. Accepts {"url": "..."} objects (same shape as Sitemap / URL-status dataset rows). Plain strings and remote lists (requestsFromUrl) also work.

datasetId.title: Source dataset ID
datasetId.description: Optional. Apify dataset ID from Sitemap URL Discovery or URL Status Checker. Reads the `url` field from each item.

keyValueStoreId.title: Source key-value store ID
keyValueStoreId.description: Optional. Load URLs from a KV record such as DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT.

keyValueRecordKey.title: Record key
keyValueRecordKey.description: Key inside the source key-value store. Ignored unless a store ID is set.

snapshotStoreId.title: Snapshot store ID
snapshotStoreId.description: Optional. Existing Apify key-value store ID that holds previous hashes/text. Prefer this for stable cross-run state. If empty, Snapshot store name is used.

snapshotStoreName.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotStoreName.description: Named KV store used when Snapshot store ID is empty. Created if missing. Use one name per monitoring project.

storePreviousText.title: Store previous text
storePreviousText.description: Save normalized text in the snapshot so the next run can emit a unified diff. Turn off to store hashes only (cheaper storage; hash change still detected).

maxStoredTextChars.title: Max stored text chars
maxStoredTextChars.description: Cap for text kept in each snapshot (characters). Diffs use this stored text.

cssSelector.title: CSS selector (main content)
cssSelector.description: Optional. Restrict hashing/diff to matching nodes (e.g. main, article, #content). Empty = whole body after stripping script/style.

ignorePatterns.title: Ignore regex patterns
ignorePatterns.description: Regex patterns removed from text before hashing (timestamps, CSRF tokens, counters). Applied with MULTILINE.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description: Stop after checking this many unique URLs (0 = no limit).

maxBodyBytes.title: Max body bytes
maxBodyBytes.description: Truncate each response body after this many bytes before extraction.

outputFilter.title: Dataset filter
outputFilter.description: Which rows to save. SUMMARY always covers every check. Successful checks are still charged when filtered out.

chargeFailedChecks.title: Charge failed checks
chargeFailedChecks.description: Default off: DNS/timeout/network failures are free. Turn on only if you want every attempted URL billed as page-checked.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy if a site blocks data-center IPs.
